title: Sold Out Until 2029. The Stock Is Still Falling.
creator: MarketBeat
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places. Guest: Lucas Downey (TradeSmith).
summary: MarketBeat host interviews TradeSmith's Lucas Downey on the AI sell-off, which he frames as overdone and driven by fear and positioning rather than fundamentals - comparing it to the earlier 'software Armageddon' scare that reversed to all-time highs. He expects the bottom within days to a couple of weeks as Q3 earnings land, and presents three fundamentally strong AI build-out names to buy the dip in: Lumentum (LITE, optical components sold out through early 2029, hyper-growth sales path, forward P/E ~35x), Dell (DELL, AI servers/storage, huge Q2 beat and Q3 guide of $6.50 EPS / $49bn revenue vs ~$41bn Street, forward P/E ~17x), and Everpure (P, formerly Pure Storage - all-flash AI storage, hyperscale wins, raised prelim FY28 revenue guide to ~$7bn vs $6.2bn Street, Quantum Edge score 88). All three are BUY calls; LITE reiterates a prior MarketBeat BUY, DELL and P are first tracked. No stance flips.

calls.video_title: Sold Out Until 2029. The Stock Is Still Falling.
calls.thesis: Guest Lucas Downey (TradeSmith) is bullish on Lumentum as a buy-the-dip AI optics leader: CEO says optical components for AI servers are sold out through early 2029, forward P/E has contracted to ~35x as earnings estimates rise while the price falls, and he 'would not be too scared to dip toes' into it after a ~15% one-week fall.
calls.base_case: Sales seen rising from just over $3bn (last 12 months) to ~$6.3bn next 12 months and ~$10bn the year after; FY27 EPS expected ~$21.70, more than doubling by FY29.
calls.bear_case: Admits more downward pressure is possible near-term; bottom judged days to a couple of weeks away, not confirmed.

calls.thesis: First tracked MarketBeat DELL call. Downey bullish on Dell as an AI server/storage cornerstone after a huge beat-and-raise: Q3 guidance EPS $6.50 and revenue $49bn vs Street ~$41bn, forward P/E ~17x (cheaper than the market); sellers are 'selling great companies' into the AI sell-off.
calls.base_case: Full-year FY27 guidance also beat and raised; infrastructure business (servers, storage, networking) is firing on all cylinders.

calls.video_title: Sold Out Until 2029. The Stock Is Still Falling.
calls.thesis: First tracked call on Everpure (ticker P, formerly Pure Storage). Downey bullish on the all-flash AI data-storage name: big hyperscale wins starting to flow through, a beat-and-raise quarter, preliminary FY28 revenue guidance raised to ~$7bn at midpoint vs Street $6.2bn, and an 88 Quantum Edge score in TradeSmith's system.
calls.base_case: Storage demand accelerates with AI workloads; business acceleration, not slowdown, is the message from company guidance.
calls.bear_case: Smaller/newer and only recently profitable, so expect more volatility than established names like Dell.
